summary: Iter 8 backend fully implemented & green (16/16 pytest). New /vessel-status endpoint works for vessel=1/2, sailed true+date and unsailed clearing; 400 on missing date and vessel=3. _regenerate_comment produces correct strings for single-vessel (no '(1st Vessel)' suffix), two-vessel Planned ETD, SOB after sail, awaiting clause switching between 'Awaiting confirmation of departure.', '…of 2nd vessel.', 'Awaiting ANF.' (FCL) and "Awaiting SOB's." (LCL). _derive_status returns only Planned/Booked/Shipped; PATCH with status=Delayed is overridden. Deprecated /mark-shipped and /mark-delayed correctly return 404, /append-comment now just regenerates. second_vessel_sob_date round-trips via PATCH. XLSX total pixel width now ~1490px (asserted 1450-1560, was ~1290 in iter 6). Logo image cy in EMU equals row1 height in px within 5px (fills row vertically) and remains horizontally centered via OneCellAnchor. FRONTEND HAS NOT BEEN UPDATED — every iter 8 frontend requirement is regressed (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown still shows 4 options ['Planned','Booked','Shipped','Delayed']. Iter 8 requires exactly 3 — remove 'Delayed'.

Still rendered as editable <Textarea data-testid=comments-textarea-{id}>. Iter 8 requires a READ-ONLY <div data-testid=comments-view-{id}> (comments are server-generated and must not be user-editable). Remove onBlur PATCH of comments too.

Old 'Delayed' + 'Shipped' date-picker buttons still present (mark-delayed-{id}, mark-shipped-{id}) and they call deprecated endpoints /mark-delayed and /mark-shipped which now return 404. They must be REMOVED and replaced with two new buttons per row: 'mark-first-sailed-{id}' (or 'unmark-first-sailed-{id}' when sob_date is set) and 'mark-second-sailed-{id}' / 'unmark-second-sailed-{id}' (only rendered when second_vessel_name is set). Both must POST /api/shipments/{id}/vessel-status with body {vessel:1|2, sailed:bool, date?:'YYYY-MM-DD'}.

integration_issues.issue: Handlers markShipped and markDelayed in ClientDetail.jsx still POST to /shipments/{id}/mark-shipped and /shipments/{id}/mark-delayed — backend now returns 404. Replace with setVesselSailed(shipId, vesselNum, isoDate) / setVesselUnsailed(shipId, vesselNum) hitting /vessel-status.

insertQuickComment still POSTs {snippet} to /append-comment; the backend now ignores the snippet and regenerates. This still returns 200, but the UI affordance is misleading — either remove the 'Preset' popover entirely (comments are now auto) or repurpose it.

issues: When comments become read-only, ensure the div preserves line breaks / wraps naturally and has consistent height with sibling cells; today the textarea provided that shape.

Convert Comments

Delete markShipped and markDelayed handlers (dead code hitting 404 endpoints).
Consider removing the QUICK_COMMENTS Preset popover since comments are now server-generated (or leave but note it just triggers regen).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still contains dead helper _auto_delayed_comment (~50 lines) and unused STATUS_OPTIONS constant that includes 'Delayed'. Remove to keep single source of truth.
server.py is 1057 lines — split XLSX/PDF builders into modules (app has grown across 8 iterations).

In _regenerate_comment, when neither planned_etd nor sob_date exist for the 1st vessel and no second vessel is set, the comment becomes '{today} - Awaiting confirmation of departure.' which is fine but empty-ish. Consider guarding.
In set_vessel_status the update dict is built twice ($set uses updates + a few merged keys). Cleaner to just $set merged fields.

Frontend markDelayed/markShipped silently 404 to user with a 'Failed' toast — because deprecated endpoints were replaced, this manifests as a broken UX for any user who clicks the still-visible Shipped/Delayed buttons.
